response.sql: WITH type_avgs AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) as type_avg FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY production_type_code), overall_avg_calc AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) as overall_avg FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL), first_kept_types AS (SELECT ta.production_type_code, ta.type_avg FROM type_avgs ta CROSS JOIN overall_avg_calc oac WHERE ta.type_avg > oac.overall_avg), mean_of_first_kept AS (SELECT AVG(type_avg) as mean_kept FROM first_kept_types), final_kept_types AS (SELECT fkt.production_type_code, fkt.type_avg FROM first_kept_types fkt CROSS JOIN mean_of_first_kept mfk WHERE fkt.type_avg > mfk.mean_kept) SELECT AVG(fkt.type_avg), AVG(fkt.type_avg - oac.overall_avg), AVG(fkt.type_avg - mfk.mean_kept) FROM final_kept_types fkt CROSS JOIN overall_avg_calc oac CROSS JOIN mean_of_first_kept mfk
